name: Whole-house water filter
definition: filter system fitted on the main supply to treat water for every tap and appliance.
notes: Own category 'Whole-house water filters' at UK Water Filters

name: Under-sink water filter
definition: filter fitted under the kitchen sink that serves a drinking-water tap.

name: Shower filter
definition: filter that treats water at the shower outlet only.

name: String inverter
definition: grid-tied inverter that takes the output of a string of solar panels; single- or three-phase is an attribute.
notes: Shop menu '1P/3P String Inverters'; 'String Inverters (175)' filter

name: Hybrid inverter
definition: inverter that works with a battery as well as panels and the grid, giving backup power.

name: Microinverter
definition: small inverter fitted at a single solar panel.

name: Off-grid inverter
definition: inverter or inverter-charger made to run a stand-alone system from a battery bank.
